# uptimeify_user (Resource)

A login of the organization. Creating it sends an invitation mail; the person sets their own password (Terraform never sets one). Destroying it deletes the login. Needs an organization admin token. Import with the user id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sends an invitation mail; the person sets their own password.
resource "uptimeify_user" "ops" {
  email      = "ops@example.com"
  first_name = "Olivia"
  last_name  = "Ops"
  role       = "editor"
}

# A customer login, limited to one customer.
resource "uptimeify_user" "shop_owner" {
  email        = "owner@shop.example"
  role         = "readonly"
  customer_ids = [12]
  language     = "en"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Login address. Changing it invites a new login (replacement).
- `role` (String) `admin`, `editor`, `readonly` or `responder`.

### Optional

- `customer_ids` (Set of Number) Customers a `readonly` login is limited to (customer user). Empty = all customers. Only allowed with `role = "readonly"`.
- `first_name` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean) `false` deactivates the login without deleting it.
- `language` (String) Language of the login (dashboard, mails); null = organization language. Only sent on create: the API cannot change it later, the person changes it in their profile. Unset = read from the API only; set, a different value read back (also one the person chose) replaces the login.
- `last_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) User id, as `user_id` in IM resources.
- `name` (String) Display name the server derives from first and last name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# User id
terraform import uptimeify_user.ops 3f1c0a8e-...
```
